mentions.name: Auxetic 3D Lattice Geometry Research
mentions.description: This project explores new auxetic geometries for 3D lattices, seeking structures that are simple, printable, and maximally effective. It compares existing designs like arrowhead lattices and gyroids and reasons from the desired mechanical mechanism to find new patterns through trial-and-error.
mentions.problem: There is no general theory for auxetic lattices, so discovery is a matter of reasoning from the desired mechanism to find patterns that fit, almost like alchemical trial-and-error.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working to figure out new auxetic geometries for 3D lattices.
